text:
jamie: quick heads-up — we have the EU demo at 02:30 UTC. vendor told us they reserved the H100 slice but asked for a final go/no-go before 02:10. @vendor-liaison can you confirm the hold and any firmware risks?

vendor-liaison: confirmed hold for the requested window. one rack hit a firmware snag during staging; vendor will either clear it by 02:05 UTC or push a spare rack. holding until 03:45 UTC as a precaution. will DM final status at ~02:10. billing approved for the burst.

anya: tio — does this need any GCP quota bump? saw a `RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED` in the smoke apply earlier.

procurement-bot: Ticket PR-4498 created and assigned to @samir for quota emergency. Priority: high. Attachments: terraform plan snippet.

samir: I’m on it, pinging cloud partner and vendor. If quota bump not approved in time we should failover to the A40 spare pool (lower perf, safer availability). I’ll update PR-4498 with next steps.

jamie: failover plan sounds good. I can open a tiny PR to change route priority so we can flip faster.

samir: route snippet I’ll drop into the PR for ops to review: ```
routes "inference" {
  priorities = ["eu-h100-reserved", "eu-a40-spare"]
  fallback = true
}
```

anya: perfect. @oncall can you stand by to flip traffic if vendor says no-go?

oncall: happy to. I’ll monitor the vendor DM and the pool metrics. If we get firmware flag, I’ll flip to A40 and post a short postmortem note in #incidents later.

jamie: thanks — vendor-liaison pls DM final status. I’ll queue the PR and set the rollout to manual so we can switch under control. :thumbsup:

vendor-liaison: will do. Current estimated final signal: 02:08 UTC. If they fail to clear firmware, they’ll provide spare nodes by 02:12.

procurement-bot: PR-4498 status updated: quota increment request sent to cloud partner; awaiting confirmation (ETA ~25m).

samir: update — cloud partner confirmed 2 extra H100s for the project, expected attach by 01:55 UTC. I’ll keep monitoring.

jamie: awesome, moving this to watch. I’ll post a short runbook in the PR for whoever flips traffic.
thread_summary: Night-window EU H100 reservation check: vendor hold, possible firmware snag, quota bump ticket PR-4498 created/assigned, fallback to A40 spare planned, route snippet provided, oncall ready to flip traffic.
